title: Berry Overnight Steel-Cut Oats
description: Soak Wefeasto Steel-Cut Oats overnight with milk, honey and berries for a chilled, no-cook breakfast that's ready when you wake up.

title: 5-Minute Muesli Yogurt Parfait
description: Layers of Wefeasto Muesli, thick curd, honey and fresh fruit stacked into a glass — a crunchy, creamy breakfast in five minutes flat.

title: No-Bake Choco Flakes Energy Bars
description: Crunchy Wefeasto Choco's pressed with peanut butter, honey and roasted peanuts into chocolatey lunchbox bars — no oven needed.

title: Health Mix Banana Smoothie Bowl
description: Frozen banana blended thick with Wefeasto Health Mix and curd, then loaded with fruit and nuts — a spoonable power breakfast.

title: Masala Cornflakes Chivda
description: Wefeasto Cornflakes tossed with curry leaves, peanuts and a light turmeric tadka — a crunchy tea-time namkeen made in ten minutes.

title: Oats With Berries Sundae
description: Wefeasto's own classic — an oats sundae layered with juicy berries and a fresh topping of fresh cream, served chilled in a tall glass.

title: Honey Nut Cornflake Clusters
description: Crunchy honey-and-ghee clusters of Wefeasto Cornflakes and toasted nuts, set firm for tea-time and lunchboxes.

title: Banana Oat Pancakes
description: Fluffy flourless blender pancakes made from Wefeasto Rolled Oats, banana and egg (or curd) — a wholesome weekend breakfast kids adore.

title: Savoury Veggie Masala Oats
description: A quick, comforting bowl of savoury masala oats loaded with veggies and a fragrant curry-leaf tadka — ready before your chai goes cold.

title: Muesli Breakfast Cookies
description: Chewy, wholesome breakfast cookies made with Wefeasto Muesli, mashed banana and peanut butter — a lightly sweetened grab-and-go treat kids actually finish.

title: Choco Flakes Chocolate Milkshake
description: A thick, frothy chocolate milkshake blended with Wefeasto Choco's and topped with crunchy flakes — the after-school treat kids beg for.

title: Warm Health Mix Porridge
description: A cosy multigrain porridge simmered with milk and jaggery, finished with toasted nuts for a filling, feel-good morning bowl.
